description:
Configure the 'Cash on delivery' payment method to reduce refused shipments.

1. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
2. Enable the 'Cash on delivery' method.
3. Change its Title to: 'Pay on Pickup'
4. Restrict the method so it is ONLY available for the 'Local Pickup' shipping method (do not allow it for Flat Rate).
5. Save your changes.

Use the WooCommerce admin panel at http://localhost/wp-admin/ (credentials: admin / Admin1234!).
